diseases.name: Frogeye Leaf Spot
symptoms: Round brown spots with purple-brown margins
Prefers warm, humid weather on young leaves

diseases.name: Septoria Brown Spot
symptoms: Small dark brown angular spots on lower leaves
Yellow halos and early leaf drop
diseases.treatmentTemplate: For {disease} in {crop} ({region}): Usually cultural control is enough; a registered fungicide at R3 pays only when defoliation is moving through the mid-canopy.

diseases.name: Gray Leaf Spot
symptoms: Rectangular gray-tan lesions parallel to veins
Lower leaves first, rising to ear leaf
diseases.treatmentTemplate: For {disease} in {crop} ({region}): Apply a registered fungicide between VT–R1 when lesions reach the ear leaf; prefer tolerant hybrids and manage residue.

diseases.name: Common Rust
diseases.treatmentTemplate: For {disease} in {crop} ({region}): Usually minor; treat with a registered fungicide only if pustules are dense before silking on susceptible hybrids.

diseases.name: Tar Spot
symptoms: Small black raised stromata embedded in leaves
Fish-eye halos later in the season
diseases.treatmentTemplate: For {disease} in {crop} ({region}): Apply a registered fungicide at VT–R1 when stromata spread to the ear leaf; incorporate residue after harvest.

diseases.name: Leaf Rust
symptoms: Orange-brown round pustules scattered on leaves
Spores rub off as rust powder
Premature leaf drying and shriveled grain
diseases.treatmentTemplate: For {disease} in {crop} ({region}): Apply a registered triazole/strobilurin at first pustules on the flag leaf or upper canopy; prefer resistant varieties.

diseases.name: Fusarium Head Blight (Scab)
symptoms: Orange spore masses at glume bases
Shriveled chalky grain with DON mycotoxin risk
diseases.treatmentTemplate: For {disease} in {crop} ({region}): Apply a registered DMI fungicide at flowering when humidity risk is high; avoid maize as previous crop; segregate damaged grain at harvest.

diseases.name: Septoria Nodorum Blotch

diseases.name: Net Blotch

diseases.name: Barley Powdery Mildew

diseases.name: Grapevine Powdery Mildew

diseases.name: Verticillium Wilt

diseases.name: Bacterial Leaf Blight
symptoms: Yellow to white stripes along leaf veins
Leaves drying from tip to base
diseases.treatmentTemplate: For {disease} in {crop} ({region}): Apply copper-based bactericides (copper oxychloride 50% WP @ 2.5g/L) at first sign. Repeat at 10-15 day intervals. Ensure field drainage. Use resistant varieties like BRRI dhan28, BRRI dhan29. Avoid excess nitrogen.
preventiveMeasures: Treat seeds with streptomycin sulphate (1g/kg seed)

diseases.name: Rice Blast
diseases.treatmentTemplate: For {disease} in {crop} ({region}): Apply tricyclazole 75% WP @ 0.6g/L or isoprothiolane 40% EC @ 1.5ml/L. Spray at tillering and panicle initiation stages. Avoid excess nitrogen. Ensure proper water management.
preventiveMeasures: Use resistant varieties (e.g., BRRI dhan33, BRRI dhan49)

diseases.name: Brown Spot
symptoms: Small circular brown spots on leaves
diseases.treatmentTemplate: For {disease} in {crop} ({region}): Apply mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5g/L or propiconazole 25% EC @ 1ml/L. Spray at early tillering and boot leaf stage. Improve soil fertility (especially Si and K).
preventiveMeasures: Use balanced fertilization (adequate K and Si)

diseases.name: Rice Tungro Disease
diseases.scientificName: Rice tungro bacilliform virus (RTBV) + Rice tungro spherical virus (RTSV)
symptoms: Small panicles with incomplete grain filling
diseases.treatmentTemplate: For {disease} in {crop} ({region}): Control green leafhopper vector with imidacloprid 17.8% SL @ 0.3ml/L or thiamethoxam 25% WG @ 0.4g/L. Remove infected plants. Use resistant varieties (e.g., BRRI dhan46, BRRI dhan56).
preventiveMeasures: Early planting to avoid vector peak

diseases.name: Sheath Blight
symptoms: Oval lesions on leaf sheaths near water level
Gray-green centers with dark brown borders
Flag leaf sheath infection reduces grain filling
diseases.treatmentTemplate: For {disease} in {crop} ({region}): Apply validamycin A 3% L @ 2.5ml/L or hexaconazole 5% SC @ 1ml/L or propiconazole 25% EC @ 1ml/L. Spray at maximum tillering and boot leaf stage. Avoid dense planting and excess nitrogen.
preventiveMeasures: Balance nitrogen with K and Si

diseases.name: False Smut
symptoms: Large greenish-black spore balls on grains
diseases.treatmentTemplate: For {disease} in {crop} ({region}): Apply propiconazole 25% EC @ 1ml/L or copper oxychloride 50% WP @ 2.5g/L at boot leaf stage. Remove smutted panicles. Use resistant varieties.

diseases.name: Bakanae (Foolish Seedling)
diseases.treatmentTemplate: For {disease} in {crop} ({region}): Seed treatment with carbendazim 50% WP @ 2g/kg or thiophanate-methyl 70% WP @ 2g/kg. Hot water treatment (52°C for 10 min). Use resistant varieties.

diseases.name: Bacterial Leaf Streak
diseases.treatmentTemplate: For {disease} in {crop} ({region}): Apply copper oxychloride 50% WP @ 2.5g/L. Field sanitation. Avoid overhead irrigation. Use resistant varieties.

diseases.name: Yellow Rust (Stripe Rust)
symptoms: Yellow-orange pustules in stripes on leaves
diseases.treatmentTemplate: For {disease} in {crop} ({region}): Apply propiconazole 25% EC @ 1ml/L or tebuconazole 25% EC @ 1ml/L or triadimefon 25% WP @ 1g/L at first appearance. Repeat after 15 days if needed. Use resistant varieties (e.g., BARI Gom 25, BARI Gom 26).

diseases.name: Brown Rust (Leaf Rust)
symptoms: Brown circular pustules scattered on leaves
diseases.treatmentTemplate: For {disease} in {crop} ({region}): Apply propiconazole 25% EC @ 1ml/L or tebuconazole 25% EC @ 1ml/L at flag leaf emergence. Use resistant varieties (e.g., BARI Gom 30, BARI Gom 31).

diseases.name: Leaf Blight
symptoms: Oval brown lesions with yellow margins
diseases.treatmentTemplate: For {disease} in {crop} ({region}): Apply mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5g/L or propiconazole 25% EC @ 1ml/L at flag leaf stage. Use resistant varieties.

diseases.name: Loose Smut
symptoms: Black spore masses replace entire grain
Only bare rachis remains at maturity
Infected heads emerge earlier than healthy
diseases.treatmentTemplate: For {disease} in {crop} ({region}): Seed treatment essential - carboxin 75% WP @ 2g/kg or tebuconazole 2% DS @ 1.25g/kg. No foliar control possible.
preventiveMeasures: Rogue out infected heads before spore release

diseases.name: Karnal Bunt
symptoms: Black powdery spores in grain crease
diseases.treatmentTemplate: For {disease} in {crop} ({region}): Apply propiconazole 25% EC @ 1ml/L at boot leaf to heading stage. Seed treatment with carboxin 75% WP @ 2g/kg. Quarantine restrictions apply for export.

diseases.name: Powdery Mildew
symptoms: White powdery patches on leaves and stems
diseases.treatmentTemplate: For {disease} in {crop} ({region}): Apply sulfur 80% WP @ 3g/L or triadimefon 25% WP @ 1g/L at first sign. Ensure good air circulation.

diseases.name: Jute Stem Rot
symptoms: Dark brown lesions at stem base
diseases.treatmentTemplate: For {disease} in {crop} ({region}): Seed treatment with carbendazim 50% WP @ 2g/kg. Soil application of Trichoderma viride @ 2.5kg/ha. Avoid waterlogging. Use resistant varieties (e.g., BJRI Deshi Pat 5, BJRI Tosha Pat 8).

diseases.name: Jute Damping Off
diseases.treatmentTemplate: For {disease} in {crop} ({region}): Seed treatment with metalaxyl + carbendazim. Ensure proper drainage. Avoid deep sowing. Use raised beds.

diseases.name: Jute Root Rot
diseases.treatmentTemplate: For {disease} in {crop} ({region}): Seed treatment with carbendazim + thiram. Soil drenching with carbendazim. Improve drainage. Crop rotation with rice.

diseases.name: Jute Leaf Spot
diseases.treatmentTemplate: For {disease} in {crop} ({region}): Apply mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5g/L or propiconazole 25% EC @ 1ml/L at first sign. Repeat at 15-day intervals.

diseases.name: Jute Mosaic Virus
diseases.treatmentTemplate: For {disease} in {crop} ({region}): Control aphid vectors with imidacloprid 17.8% SL @ 0.3ml/L. Use virus-free seed. Remove infected plants. Reflective mulches reduce aphid landing.

diseases.name: Late Blight
diseases.treatmentTemplate: For {disease} in {crop} ({region}): Apply cymoxanil 8% + mancozeb 64% WP @ 2.5g/L or dimethomorph 50% WP @ 1g/L or mandipropamid 23.4% SC @ 0.8ml/L. Spray preventively at 7-10 day intervals in favorable weather. Destroy cull piles.
preventiveMeasures: Resistant varieties (e.g., BARI Alu 7, BARI Alu 8)

diseases.name: Early Blight
symptoms: Dark brown lesions with yellow halo
diseases.treatmentTemplate: For {disease} in {crop} ({region}): Apply mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5g/L or azoxystrobin 23% SC @ 1ml/L or difenoconazole 25% EC @ 0.5ml/L. Spray at 10-14 day intervals from flowering.

diseases.name: Bacterial Wilt
symptoms: Brown vascular ring in stem cross-section
diseases.treatmentTemplate: For {disease} in {crop} ({region}): No effective chemical control. Rogue out infected plants immediately. Soil fumigation with formaldehyde. Long rotation (4-5 years) with non-solanaceous crops. Use resistant varieties (e.g., BARI Alu 7).

diseases.name: Potato Virus Y (PVY)
diseases.treatmentTemplate: For {disease} in {crop} ({region}): Control aphid vectors with imidacloprid 17.8% SL @ 0.3ml/L as seed treatment or flonicamid 50% WG @ 0.2g/L. Use certified virus-free seed. Remove infected plants. Reflective mulches reduce aphid landing.
preventiveMeasures: Remove volunteer potatoes and solanaceous weeds

diseases.name: Common Scab
diseases.treatmentTemplate: For {disease} in {crop} ({region}): Maintain soil pH 5.0-5.2 (acidic). Adequate soil moisture during tuber initiation (6-8 weeks after planting). Use resistant varieties (e.g., BARI Alu 7, BARI Alu 8). Apply organic matter.

diseases.name: Black Leg
diseases.treatmentTemplate: For {disease} in {crop} ({region}): Use certified disease-free seed. Proper storage ventilation. Avoid mechanical damage. Crop rotation. Copper-based bactericides at planting.

symptoms: Small tan lesions on lower leaves
Severe yield loss if early infection
diseases.treatmentTemplate: Para {disease} em {crop} ({region}): Aplique fungicidas triazóis (epoxiconazol, ciproconazol) + estrobilurinas (azoxistrobina, piraclostrobina) no estádio R1-R3. Monitoramento semanal com armadilhas de esporos. Use cultivares resistentes (ex: TMG 7062 RR, BRS 1010 IPRO).

diseases.name: Frog Eye Leaf Spot
symptoms: Circular gray lesions with dark red-brown margins
Gray center with tiny black dots (pseudostromata)
diseases.treatmentTemplate: Para {disease} em {crop} ({region}): Aplique fungicidas SDHI (fluxapiroxade, bixafeno) + triazóis no estádio R3-R5. Rotação com milho reduz inóculo. Sementes tratadas com carboxina + tiram.

diseases.name: Target Spot
diseases.treatmentTemplate: Para {disease} em {crop} ({region}): Aplique fungicidas multissítio (mancozeb, clorotalonil) + sítio específico (azoxistrobina, bixafeno) no fechamento de entrelinhas. Evite irrigação por aspersão.

diseases.name: Stem Canker
diseases.treatmentTemplate: Para {disease} em {crop} ({region}): Não há controle químico curativo. Use cultivares resistentes. Tratamento de sementes com fungicidas sistêmicos. Rotação com milho (2+ anos). Evite ferimentos durante operações.

diseases.name: Pod and Stem Blight
symptoms: Black pycnidia in rows on mature stems
diseases.treatmentTemplate: Para {disease} em {crop} ({region}): Colheita na época correta (umidade 13-14%). Fungicidas no estádio R5-R6 (azoxistrobina + ciproconazol). Secagem rápida pós-colheita. Armazenamento arejado.

diseases.name: Root Rot
diseases.scientificName: Phytophthora sojae / Pythium spp. / Rhizoctonia solani
symptoms: Morte de plantas em áreas baixas
diseases.treatmentTemplate: Para {disease} em {crop} ({region}): Tratamento de sementes com metalaxil + fluxapiroxade ou etaboxam. Cultivares com genes Rps (resistência a Phytophthora). Drenagem adequada. Evite plantio profundo.

diseases.name: Common Rust
symptoms: Pústulas cinamomo em ambas superfícies foliares
Teliósporos pretos no final da safra
diseases.treatmentTemplate: Para {disease} em {crop} ({region}): Aplique mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5g/L ou propiconazol 25% EC @ 1ml/L no início da infecção. Use híbridos resistentes.

diseases.name: Southern Rust
symptoms: Pústulas mais densas que ferrugem comum
diseases.treatmentTemplate: Para {disease} em {crop} ({region}): Aplique fungicidas triazóis + estrobilurinas (epoxiconazol + piraclostrobina) no estádio VT-R1. Monitoramento constante. Híbridos tolerantes.

diseases.name: Gray Leaf Spot
diseases.treatmentTemplate: Para {disease} em {crop} ({region}): Aplique azoxistrobina 23% SC @ 1ml/L ou piraclostrobina 20% WG @ 0.6g/L ou propiconazol 25% EC @ 1ml/L no estádio VT. Repita se necessário.

diseases.name: Northern Corn Leaf Blight
symptoms: Lesões tornam-se marrom-claro com margens escuras
diseases.treatmentTemplate: Para {disease} em {crop} ({region}): Aplique mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5g/L ou azoxistrobina 23% SC @ 1ml/L ou propiconazol 25% EC @ 1ml/L no primeiro sinal. Repita em intervalos de 15 dias.

diseases.name: Ear Rot
symptoms: Mofo branco a rosa nos grãos
Apodrecimento dos grãos a partir do ápice
diseases.treatmentTemplate: Para {disease} em {crop} ({region}): Colheita na umidade correta (20-25%). Secagem rápida <14% umidade. Armazenamento arejado. Nenhuma pulverização eficaz no campo; prevenção crítica. Use híbridos resistentes.

diseases.name: Stalk Rot
diseases.scientificName: Fusarium moniliforme / Colletotrichum graminicola / Gibberella zeae
diseases.treatmentTemplate: Para {disease} em {crop} ({region}): Manejo de estresse hídrico. Evite adubação nitrogenada excessiva. Colheita antecipada de áreas com acamamento. Híbridos com boa permanência de planta.

diseases.name: Coffee Leaf Rust
symptoms: Manchas amarela-alaranjadas na face inferior das folhas
Severo no terço inferior da copa
diseases.treatmentTemplate: Para {disease} em {crop} ({region}): Aplique fungicidas triazóis (epoxiconazol, ciproconazol) ou estrobilurinas. Poda para arejamento. Use cultivares resistentes (Catuaí Vermelho IAC 144, Obatã IAC 1669-20).

diseases.name: Coffee Berry Borer
symptoms: Pequeno orifício de entrada no fruto
diseases.treatmentTemplate: Para {disease} em {crop} ({region}): Controle integrado: armadilhas com etanol+metanol (1:1), liberação de parasitoides (Cephalonomia stephanoderis, Prorops nasuta), fungos entomopatogênicos (Beauveria bassiana). Colheita total (varrição).

diseases.name: Coffee Leaf Miner
diseases.treatmentTemplate: Para {disease} em {crop} ({region}): Aplique inseticidas sistêmicos (tiometoxam, imidacloprid) via solo ou foliar. Controle biológico com vespas parasitoides. Poda de limpeza.

diseases.name: Cercospora Leaf Spot (Coffee)
symptoms: Manchas circulares marrom-claras com halo amarelo
diseases.treatmentTemplate: Para {disease} em {crop} ({region}): Aplique mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5g/L ou clorotalonil 75% WP @ 2g/L ou propiconazol 25% EC @ 1ml/L. Poda para ventilação. Remova folhas caídas.

diseases.name: Coffee Root Rot
diseases.scientificName: Rhizoctonia solani / Fusarium spp. / Phytophthora spp.
diseases.treatmentTemplate: Para {disease} em {crop} ({region}): Mudas sadias de viveiros certificados. Tratamento de mudas com fungicidas (carboxina + tiram). Drenagem eficiente. Solarização do solo. Cultivares tolerantes.

diseases.name: Red Rot
symptoms: Cheiro alcoólico ao fender a cana
Folhas do topo amareladas e secas
diseases.treatmentTemplate: Para {disease} em {crop} ({region}): Não há controle químico curativo. Elimine toletes doentes. Tratamento de toletes com carbendazim 50% WP @ 1g/L por 10 min. Use variedades resistentes (RB 867515, RB 92579, CTC 4).
preventiveMeasures: Rotação de culturas (2-3 anos com soja/feijão)

diseases.name: Smut

diseases.name: Gray Leaf Spot

diseases.name: Northern Corn Leaf Blight

diseases.name: Southern Rust
symptoms: Pustules more dense than common rust
diseases.treatmentTemplate: For {disease} in {crop} ({region}): Apply triazole + strobilurin fungicides (epoxiconazole + pyraclostrobin) at VT-R1. Constant monitoring. Tolerant hybrids.

diseases.name: Ear Rot
symptoms: White to pink mold on kernels
diseases.treatmentTemplate: For {disease} in {crop} ({region}): Harvest at proper moisture (20-25%). Dry quickly to <14% moisture. Store in aerated conditions. No effective field spray; prevention critical. Use resistant hybrids.

diseases.name: Stalk Rot
diseases.scientificName: Fusarium moniliforme / Colletotrichum graminicola / Gibberella zeae
diseases.treatmentTemplate: For {disease} in {crop} ({region}): Manage water stress. Avoid excessive nitrogen. Early harvest of lodged areas. Hybrids with good standability.

diseases.name: Downy Mildew
diseases.treatmentTemplate: For {disease} in {crop} ({region}): Seed treatment with metalaxyl-M + mancozib. Rogue out systemically infected plants. Use resistant hybrids. Avoid maize after maize in infected fields.

diseases.name: Cassava Mosaic Disease
diseases.scientificName: African cassava mosaic virus (ACMV) / East African cassava mosaic virus (EACMV)
diseases.treatmentTemplate: For {disease} in {crop} ({region}): Use virus-free stem cuttings. Control whitefly with imidacloprid soil application. Remove infected plants. Use resistant varieties (e.g., TME 419, TMS 30572, NR 8082).

diseases.name: Cassava Brown Streak Disease
diseases.scientificName: Cassava brown streak virus (CBSV) / Ugandan cassava brown streak virus (UCBSV)
diseases.treatmentTemplate: For {disease} in {crop} ({region}): Use virus-free planting material. Remove infected plants immediately. Control whitefly vectors. Use resistant varieties (e.g., NAROCASS 1, NAROCASS 2). No chemical control.

diseases.name: Cassava Bacterial Blight
symptoms: Spots turn brown with yellow halo
diseases.treatmentTemplate: For {disease} in {crop} ({region}): Use disease-free cuttings. Copper-based bactericides (copper oxychloride 50% WP @ 2.5g/L). Remove infected plants. Avoid overhead irrigation. Crop rotation.

diseases.name: Cassava Root Rot
diseases.scientificName: Phytophthora spp. / Fusarium spp. / Rhizoctonia solani
diseases.treatmentTemplate: For {disease} in {crop} ({region}): Use healthy cuttings from disease-free fields. Ensure good drainage. Avoid waterlogging. Fungicide drench with metalaxyl + mancozeb. Crop rotation.

diseases.name: Cassava Green Mite

diseases.treatmentTemplate: For {disease} in {crop} ({region}): Apply abamectin 1.8% EC @ 0.5ml/L or spiromesifen 22.9% SC @ 1ml/L. Biological control with Typhlodromalus aripo. Resistant varieties.

diseases.name: Cassava Mealybug
diseases.treatmentTemplate: For {disease} in {crop} ({region}): Biological control with Anagyrus lopezi (parasitic wasp). Neem-based sprays. Remove infested tips. Resistant varieties.

diseases.name: Yam Mosaic Virus

diseases.name: Yam Anthracnose
diseases.treatmentTemplate: For {disease} in {crop} ({region}): Apply mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5g/L or propiconazole 25% EC @ 1ml/L. Remove infected vines. Use healthy seed yams. Proper curing before storage.

diseases.name: Yam Dry Rot
symptoms: White to pink mycelium in cavities
diseases.treatmentTemplate: For {disease} in {crop} ({region}): Careful harvesting to avoid wounds. Cure tubers properly (28-30°C, 85-90% RH). Fungicide dip (thiabendazole). Ventilated storage.

diseases.name: Yam Soft Rot
diseases.treatmentTemplate: For {disease} in {crop} ({region}): No chemical control. Careful handling. Proper curing and drying. Ventilated storage. Remove infected tubers immediately.

diseases.name: Yam Nematode
diseases.treatmentTemplate: For {disease} in {crop} ({region}): Hot water treatment of setts (50-55°C for 40 min). Nematicide application. Crop rotation with non-hosts. Organic amendments (neem cake).

diseases.name: Yam Scale

diseases.name: Bacterial Leaf Blight

preventiveMeasures: Treat seeds with streptomycin sulphate (1g/kg seed)

diseases.name: Rice Blast
diseases.treatmentTemplate: For {disease} in {crop} ({region}): Apply tricyclazole 75% WP @ 0.6g/L or isoprothiolane 40% EC @ 1.5ml/L. Spray at tillering and panicle initiation stages. Avoid excess nitrogen. Ensure proper water management.
preventiveMeasures: Use resistant varieties (e.g., FARO 44, FARO 52, FARO 57)

diseases.name: Brown Spot
symptoms: Small circular brown spots on leaves
diseases.treatmentTemplate: For {disease} in {crop} ({region}): Apply mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5g/L or propiconazole 25% EC @ 1ml/L. Spray at early tillering and boot leaf stage. Improve soil fertility (especially Si and K).
preventiveMeasures: Use balanced fertilization (adequate K and Si)

diseases.name: Rice Tungro Disease

preventiveMeasures: Early planting to avoid vector peak

diseases.name: Sheath Blight

Flag leaf sheath infection reduces grain filling
diseases.treatmentTemplate: For {disease} in {crop} ({region}): Apply validamycin A 3% L @ 2.5ml/L or hexaconazole 5% SC @ 1ml/L or propiconazole 25% EC @ 1ml/L. Spray at maximum tillering and boot leaf stage. Avoid dense planting and excess nitrogen.
preventiveMeasures: Balance nitrogen with K and Si

diseases.name: Rice Yellow Mottle Virus
diseases.treatmentTemplate: For {disease} in {crop} ({region}): Control beetle vector with insecticides. Remove infected plants. Use resistant varieties (e.g., FARO 52, FARO 57). Weed control in bunds.

diseases.name: Bakanae (Foolish Seedling)
diseases.treatmentTemplate: For {disease} in {crop} ({region}): Seed treatment with carbendazim 50% WP @ 2g/kg or thiophanate-methyl 70% WP @ 2g/kg. Hot water treatment (52°C for 10 min). Use resistant varieties.

diseases.name: Narrow Brown Spot
diseases.treatmentTemplate: For {disease} in {crop} ({region}): Apply propiconazole 25% EC @ 1ml/L or mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5g/L at boot leaf stage. Use resistant varieties. Balanced nutrition.

diseases.name: Sorghum Downy Mildew

diseases.name: Sorghum Anthracnose
diseases.treatmentTemplate: For {disease} in {crop} ({region}): Apply mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5g/L or propiconazole 25% EC @ 1ml/L. Seed treatment with thiabendazole. Use resistant varieties. Crop rotation.

diseases.name: Sorghum Grain Mold

diseases.name: Sorghum Ergot

diseases.name: Sorghum Leaf Blight
symptoms: Lesions turn tan with reddish margins
diseases.treatmentTemplate: For {disease} in {crop} ({region}): Apply mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5g/L or propiconazole 25% EC @ 1ml/L at first sign. Repeat at 14-day intervals. Use resistant varieties.

diseases.name: Sorghum Rust
diseases.treatmentTemplate: For {disease} in {crop} ({region}): Apply mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5g/L or propiconazole 25% EC @ 1ml/L at early infection. Use resistant varieties.

diseases.name: Sorghum Smut

Powder of yellow spores rubs off easily
Stripes follow veins; leaves may dry prematurely

symptoms: Reddish-brown, elongated pustules on stems and leaf sheaths
Pustules rupture epidermis leaving ragged edges
Black spore stage late in season; lodging
diseases.treatmentTemplate: For {disease} in {crop} ({region}): Apply propiconazole 25% EC @ 1ml/L immediately; repeat after 15 days if pressure continues. Use Ug99-resistant varieties and destroy barberry hosts.
preventiveMeasures: Timely sowing to escape peak rust

diseases.name: Loose Smut
symptoms: Black powdery spore masses replace grain heads
Affected heads emerge earlier and darker
Spores blown away leaving bare stalk
diseases.treatmentTemplate: For {disease} in {crop} ({region}): No field spray works once heads appear. Use certified seed treated with carboxin+thiram or solar seed treatment. Rogue out smutted heads before spore release.

diseases.name: Cotton Leaf Curl Virus (CLCuD)
symptoms: Upward/downward curling of leaves with thickened veins
diseases.treatmentTemplate: For {disease} in {crop} ({region}): No cure once infected — remove and destroy infected plants. Control whitefly vector with imidacloprid/acetamiprid rotations and yellow sticky traps. Plant resistant varieties (e.g., CIM series).
preventiveMeasures: Early complete destruction of previous crop stubble

diseases.name: Pink Bollworm
symptoms: Bolls with interlocular feeding and stained lint
diseases.treatmentTemplate: For {disease} in {crop} ({region}): Deploy pheromone traps @ 5/ha and mating disruption. Apply emamectin benzoate or spinosad at economic threshold. Never carryover lint/seed between seasons.
preventiveMeasures: Short, uniform fruiting season; close season
Destroy crop residues and ginning waste

diseases.name: Bacterial Blight
symptoms: Angular, water-soaked leaf spots turning brown-black
Black veins and black arm (stem) phases
diseases.treatmentTemplate: For {disease} in {crop} ({region}): Spray copper oxychloride 50% WP @ 2.5g/L + streptomycin @ 0.1g/L. Use acid-delinted certified seed; avoid overhead irrigation.
preventiveMeasures: Crop rotation out of cotton 1–2 seasons
Avoid wounding and excess canopy humidity

diseases.name: Rice Blast
symptoms: Diamond-shaped gray centers with brown margins on leaves
Node and neck infections blacken and break the panicle
diseases.treatmentTemplate: For {disease} in {crop} ({region}): Apply tricyclazole 75% WP @ 0.6g/L or azoxystrobin @ 1ml/L at first lesions; protect neck at heading. Split nitrogen; keep fields drained when possible.
preventiveMeasures: Use resistant varieties (e.g., Super Basmati lines with blast resistance)
Treat seed and remove infected stubble

diseases.name: Bacterial Leaf Blight
symptoms: Yellow to straw-colored lesions from leaf tips, wavy margins
Milky droplets that dry as beads on leaf surface
Grayish, rolled leaf tips (kresek in young plants)
diseases.treatmentTemplate: For {disease} in {crop} ({region}): Spray copper-based compounds + validamycin where labelled. Drain and dry the field briefly. No curative chemistry once systemic — focus on resistant varieties and balanced nutrition.
preventiveMeasures: Sanitize tools and drain between paddies

diseases.name: Sheath Blight
symptoms: Gray-green, oval lesions with brown borders on leaf sheaths near waterline
Lesions move up the plant in humid canopies
diseases.treatmentTemplate: For {disease} in {crop} ({region}): Apply validamycin 3% L @ 2ml/L or azoxystrobin 23% SC @ 1ml/L at first lesions; repeat at 10–12 days in humid weather.

diseases.name: Fall Armyworm
symptoms: Ragged leaf holes and 'window pane' feeding
Larvae with inverted Y marking on the head
diseases.treatmentTemplate: For {disease} in {crop} ({region}): Whorl-application of emamectin benzoate 5% SG @ 0.4g/L or spinetoram in evening hours. Push-pull intercropping and pheromone traps @ 5/ha for monitoring.
preventiveMeasures: Conserve natural enemies; avoid broad-spectrum sprays

diseases.name: Red Rot
symptoms: Long red lesions with white centers on canes

Drying of leaves top-down; internal reddening
diseases.treatmentTemplate: For {disease} in {crop} ({region}): No effective cure — rogue out infected clumps and burn. Sett treatment with carbendazim @ 0.1% or hot-water (52°C, 30 min) before planting. Use healthy seed cane.

diseases.name: Whip Smut
symptoms: Black, whip-like smutted stalk from the growing point
diseases.treatmentTemplate: For {disease} in {crop} ({region}): Rogue out whips, bag before cutting and burn. Treat setts with fungicide or hot water (50°C for 2 h). Replace infected stools with healthy seed.
preventiveMeasures: Three-eye budded setts from top portion

Kresek wilting in very young plants

diseases.name: Rice Tungro

symptoms: Yellow-orange leaf discoloration starting from tips

diseases.treatmentTemplate: For {disease} in {crop} ({region}): No cure — rogue infected hills. Control green leafhopper with approved insecticide at early infection; coordinate synchronous planting across the area.

diseases.name: Brown Spot
symptoms: Brown oval spots with gray centers
diseases.treatmentTemplate: For {disease} in {crop} ({region}): Apply mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5g/L at flag leaf. Correct soil fertility — brown spot thrives in poor soils, especially lacking potassium.

diseases.name: Corn Downy Mildew
symptoms: White downy growth on leaf undersides
diseases.treatmentTemplate: For {disease} in {crop} ({region}): Apply metalaxyl-based seed treatment or foliar spray early. Rogue infected plants; plant resistant varieties and avoid overlapping planting calendars.

diseases.name: Fall Armyworm
symptoms: Ragged whorl feeding with window-pane holes
Larvae with inverted Y on the head
diseases.treatmentTemplate: For {disease} in {crop} ({region}): Apply emamectin benzoate 5% SG @ 0.4g/L directed into whorls in the evening. Scout weekly; use pheromone traps and native enemies.

diseases.name: Common Rust
symptoms: Premature leaf drying in severe cases
diseases.treatmentTemplate: For {disease} in {crop} ({region}): Apply mancozeb 75% WP @ 2.5g/L at early infection. Favor resistant hybrids; avoid heavy late nitrogen.

diseases.name: Black Sigatoka
symptoms: Dark streaks turning black with yellow halos

diseases.treatmentTemplate: For {disease} in {crop} ({region}): Remove infected leaves; apply systemic fungicides (triazole/strobilurin rotation) per disease cycle. Improve drainage and plant spacing.

diseases.name: Banana Bunchy Top Virus
symptoms: Dark green hook-shaped streaks along leaf veins
Bunched, stunted leaves at the crown
diseases.treatmentTemplate: For {disease} in {crop} ({region}): No cure — destroy infected mats (inject herbicide or uproot and chop). Control banana aphids; use virus-free tissue-cultured planting material.

diseases.name: Coconut Rhinoceros Beetle
symptoms: V- or diamond-shaped cut in unfolded fronds
Holes chewed in the bud region
Weakened crowns and reduced nut set
diseases.treatmentTemplate: For {disease} in {crop} ({region}): Hook out beetles from breeding sites (dead logs, manure piles). Use pheromone traps, biological control (Oryctes baculovirus, Metarhizium) and fill crown axils with sand/naphthalene balls.
preventiveMeasures: Green-manure cover to deter egg laying
Crown axil protection in young palms

diseases.name: Grapevine Powdery Mildew

diseases.name: Tomato Yellow Leaf Curl Virus

diseases.name: Tomato Late Blight

diseases.name: Yellow (Stripe) Rust

diseases.name: Septoria Leaf Blotch
diseases.treatmentTemplate: For {disease} in {crop} ({region}): Treat at T1–T2 with authorized fungicides, rotating modes of action; bury residue.
